h: Speed Darlington claims he is Nigeria's richest musician as he shows off 18-room mansion
p: Singer Speed Darlington has described himself as the richest musician in Nigeria while showing off his 18-room mansion and what he called the only sky pool in the country.
body: Singer and entertainer Speed Darlington has stirred reactions online after describing himself as the richest musician in Nigeria.

In a video recorded after a swim at his 18-room mansion, the singer showed off the property and claimed that no other Nigerian musician owns a home with a sky pool like his. He said his house was number one in Nigeria and that anyone who doubted him did not understand the industry.
more: He claims to have the only sky pool in Nigeria.
